additional_info.subject: RE: ID0433215-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/S3300000004064] Outlet 1: outoforder, MeterState: Working CRM:02919000024
additional_info.body:
Dear Yunus Emre Temel,
We have observed that the charger is currently offline on the SCB platform, and unfortunately, I am unable to access it remotely for diagnostics.
Could you please try to reboot the charger manually on-site?
I have analyzed the system logs and found that the outlet is currently out of order due to a SECC error.
Kindly check the connection between the SECC and Outlet 1.
Check if the Ethernet cable is properly attached to the switch. It come from +F03-KF12 (J10) output through WD5 cable and it reaches the +F03-XF1:P5
If we cannot check the connectivity, we can test replacing the Ethernet cable.
If it doesn't work then try replacing the KF12 and see if it works.
Check if the 24V are being applied correctly to KF12 coming from the +F03-XD3:18C to the VDC input of the KF12
If there are no 24V being applied to KF12, please check if the XD3 connector is correctly fitted and there are no loose connections
Otherwise please check if FC15 is tripped and having 24V output.
If the SECC is found to be faulty, please proceed with its replacement.
MLFB-
8EM5903-0AA00-5AA6 -KF12 SECC Charge Controller 1x CCS2
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
